001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import java.net.URI;
005
006import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
007import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.format.IPathFormatter;
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IKindTest;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * A node item that represents the root of a tree of nodes associated with a
015 * document resource.
016 */
017public interface IDocumentNodeItem extends IDocumentBasedNodeItem {
018  /**
019   * The node item's type.
020   *
021   * @return the type
022   */
023  @NonNull
024  static IItemType type() {
025    return IItemType.document();
026  }
027
028  @Override
029  default IKindTest<IDocumentNodeItem> getType() {
030    return IItemType.document(
031        getRootAssemblyNodeItem().getType());
032  }
033
034  @Override
035  default NodeItemKind getNodeItemKind() {
036    return NodeItemKind.DOCUMENT;
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  default NodeType getNodeType() {
041    return NodeType.DOCUMENT;
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  default IDocumentNodeItem getNodeItem() {
046    return this;
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  @NonNull
051  URI getDocumentUri();
052
053  /**
054   * Get the node item for the document root element.
055   *
056   * @return the root node item
057   */
058  @NonNull
059  IRootAssemblyNodeItem getRootAssemblyNodeItem();
060
061  @Override
062  default String format(@NonNull IPathFormatter formatter) {
063    return formatter.formatDocument(this);
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  default <CONTEXT, RESULT> RESULT accept(@NonNull INodeItemVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> visitor, CONTEXT context) {
068    return visitor.visitDocument(this, context);
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  default boolean deepEquals(ICollectionValue other, DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
073    return other instanceof IDocumentNodeItem
074        && NodeComparators.compareNodeItem(this, (IDocumentNodeItem) other, dynamicContext);
075  }
076}
